name: acc-0017
description: Acceptance 0017: an owner `run request --hold` with an interactive ssh session, released by another process: the release settles in seconds, the owner exits only after Released; killed: the owner is SIGKILLed right after the release was asked and the release client takes the invocation over.

actions.label: Run 0017
actions.description: A second process releases the invocation whose owner holds an interactive ssh session.

actions.label: Run 0017 killedlate
actions.description: The owner is killed (SIGKILL) 2 s after the release was asked, while it stops its kcp; the invocation still ends Released with kcpRunning false.

actions.label: Run 0017 devsup
actions.description: dev up, then 12 times dev down SIGKILLed mid-stop and dev up at once: every kcp ready (a real devsup, no VM).

actions.label: Run 0017 half
actions.description: A release of an invocation whose application is gone but whose summary does not say Released fails and keeps the state.

actions.label: Run 0017 killed
actions.description: The owner is killed (SIGKILL) 100 ms after the release was asked; the release still completes.

hooks.reason: every record of the run RecordNotFound after the release
